plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Progressive serving — instead of live chunked streaming, the proxy now downloads tracks to disk first and serves progressively from the partial file. This fixes playback on Squeezebox Radio, piCorePlayer, and other hardware that struggles with live chunked streams.
plugin.creator: schmij97
